claim: Under a common future apparatus, a specified record statistic predicts terminal continuation beyond current expression and declared strong conventional summaries.
implementation: Generation-14 common-O writer analysis of completed paired-cue histories.
complete_boundary: declared task, reader/writer, ports and future disturbance contract
candidate: signed task-aligned 64-step normalized linear cue transfer of the O packet computable at generation 14
endpoint: generation-32 scattered terminal assay; both cues pass strict margin >0.25
endpoint_exclusions: individual-state capacity estimated from repeated trials
inference_unit: eight complete blocks, each with four founders and four recipients across four related histories
exposure: All terminal outcomes and aggregate generation-14 performance were already known. No inspected E051 block is an untouched holdout.
proposed_holdout: A later frozen evaluation using genuinely unexposed contexts, with programme-wide exposure recorded before launch; not specified or authorized as a confirmatory experiment here.
assumptions: Current-state measurements and outgoing O packet use no later state.
All included histories use O at generations 14 through 32 under matched future disturbance draws within lineage context.
Whole-block exclusion prevents sharing a block between training and test data.
Approximate expression matching is an operating definition, not proof of equal capacity or causal mediation identification.
Signed transfer may fail to summarize the nonlinear future process.
required_controls: all quadratic products of four current-output signals
negative_controls_and_checks: held-out label perturbation leaves fit/prediction unchanged
held-out feature perturbation leaves training preprocessing unchanged
original packet and output replay across source runs
independent native capture and transfer cross-checks
effect_direction: Adding signed transfer lowers equal-block excluded Brier error relative to the fixed quadratic expression/history/unsigned-access model.
matching: Same context, spaced versus clustered; both currently pass and all four output differences <=0.02. No outcome filtering or caliper sweep.
uncertainty: Display all eight block score differences and all matched-subset counts. Eight already-exposed blocks and a single future draw per state do not justify a confirmatory or individual-capacity claim.
rejection_or_narrowing: Nonpositive primary incremental Brier improvement rejects this specified predictive increment in this development cohort.
A simpler model matching or exceeding performance narrows the need for the proposed reconstruction feature.
Sparse matches restrict the matched-expression claim; the caliper stays fixed.
A positive increment with poor simple-baseline performance is not sufficient support for predictive compression.
Current expression explaining the terminal difference weakens the hidden-continuation reading of the spacing result.
interpretation_of_positive: Development lead requiring frozen unexposed testing; not a new mathematical law or confirmation of RDT.
interpretation_of_negative: Retain failure of this candidate; do not change depth, features, caliper or outcome to recover a favorable result.
interpretation_of_ambiguous: State the coverage and rival-model limitations and leave P02 unresolved.
confirmatory_quantities_status: Require development justification and freezing before unexposed outcomes; not invented here.
claim_level: PROPOSED_EMPIRICAL_LAW; only the conditional sufficiency derivation is EXACT_OR_KNOWN
